title: Before You Play - Hold Your Guitar

lesson.instructions: Sit comfortably with relaxed shoulders and support the guitar so your left hand does not need to hold it up. The video demonstrates a classical position: use a suitable guitar support or a footstool under your left foot if comfortable. Choose the open high E target, start listening and pluck the thin string gently. Try three separate plucks at your own pace. The app checks the sound, not your posture. Finish when you feel comfortable.
